note: Provenance of atomic-request-v2-vectors.json: a verbatim copy of atomic-server's golden v2 request-signature vectors at atomic-server commit 0fa9c07 (the candidate20 pin), unchanged through 7dab1ce: the candidate21 pin e922179 and atomic-server 7dab1ce have the same file (same SHA-256). signature::tests checks the copy's SHA-256 against this file (an edit fails the tests) and, when ATOMIC_SERVER_CHECKOUT is set, compares it with that checkout's copy; refresh both together when atomic-server changes the vectors.
